gold_assessment.reasoning: Gold: headache as chief complaint. Generated CC states a 3‑day severe blinding headache; duration and severity are added and not present in Gold CC fact.
Gold: 3‑day history of headache. Generated CC contains 3‑day history but is in Chief_Complaint, not HPI; no generated HPI fact explicitly states 3‑day history.
Gold: headache starts on waking up. Generated hpi-001: onset on waking; hpi-006: present on waking. This captures the Gold fact.
Gold: over the right eye. Generated hpi-001: increased over R eye. Location over right eye is captured.
Gold: seeing lights in front of eyes. Generated hpi-003: intermittent flashing lights. Same symptom of visual lights during headache.

Gold: worse when stands up but not with bending/cough/sneeze. Generated hpi-005: worse with quick standing/head turning. Standing piece is similar but there is no mention that it is NOT worse with bending, coughing, or sneezing, so this exact contrast is not captured.

Gold: intensity 5–8/10 with no explicit ibuprofen effect on the scale. Generated hpi-002 states 8→5 with ibuprofen, which is a specific pattern not present in Gold. The Gold range itself is not explicitly reproduced.
Gold: ibuprofen eases slightly but not resolving. Generated hpi-002: partial relief with ibuprofen; med-002: ibuprofen PRN. These reflect slight/partial relief without resolution.
Gold: was well before this episode. No generated HPI fact states prior good health or normal baseline.
Gold: lacking in energy but no weight loss. No generated fact mentions energy, fatigue, or weight loss.
Gold: previous mild generalized headaches with altered vision. No generated fact describes prior headache history or prior altered vision separate from current episode.
Gold: worse in light (photophobia). Generated hpi-003: associated with photophobia. Same symptom.

Gold: vision not disturbed during current episode. Generated hpi-003 and others do not explicitly say vision is normal, but ros-008 in Gold is the explicit statement. The Generated set has no direct counterpart; thus from HPI perspective this is omitted. However, since this fact is HPI, and there is no Generated HPI fact denying disturbance, it is best classified as OMITTED.
Gold: PMH nil. Generated pmh-001 introduces resolved childhood abdominal pain instead; does not state PMH is nil.
Gold: Mercilon. Generated: Marcelone. Different drug names; this is not a clear alternate spelling of Mercilon and should be treated as contradictory medication detail.
Gold: ibuprofen self-treatment. Generated med-002: ibuprofen PRN. Captures ibuprofen use.
Gold: mother has migraine. Generated fh-001: mother with migraines. Same content.
Gold: non-smoker. Generated sh-003: non-smoker. Same.
Gold: no illicit drugs. Generated sh-004: no recreational drugs. Equivalent for clinical purposes.
Gold: ~3 beers/week. Generated sh-002: ~3 beers/wk. Same.
Gold: works from home. Generated sh-001: lives alone; works from home. Work-from-home element is covered.

Gold: impression likely migraine (without explicit mention of aura vs other etiologies). Generated asm-001 discusses ?migraine with aura vs other etiology, which is more tentative and different; the simple statement "likely migraine" is not directly reproduced.

Gold: needs neurological exam to exclude other pathology. Generated plan-001: urgent in-person neuro exam including fundoscopy & BP. This covers arranging neurological examination; exclusion of other pathology is implicit but the exam arrangement is clearly present.
Gold: advised regular paracetamol. Generated plan-002: prescribe stronger NSAID + paracetamol. Paracetamol advice is covered, though strength/NSAID is added.
Gold: prescribed anti-inflammatory to take with food. Generated plan-002: stronger NSAID (an anti-inflammatory) + paracetamol; take with food. Same core plan.

Gold: contact straightaway or go to A&E if severe/unrelenting. Generated plan-003/fu-001: seek ED care if red flags/worsening/neuro changes. Not identical wording but concept of ED for worsening/red flag severe symptoms is captured.
Gold: no nausea/vomiting. Generated hpi-004: mild nausea; no vomiting. Nausea presence directly contradicts Gold report of no nausea.
Gold: no altered taste or smell. No generated fact mentions taste or smell.
Gold: no rash. No generated fact references rash.
Gold: no fever. Generated hpi-007: denies fever among other items. Fever absence covered.

Gold: no coryzal symptoms. Generated hpi-007 mentions no URI, sinus, ENT symptoms which is broader; however, coryzal symptoms specifically are not explicitly mirrored. This could be argued as covered but is more generalized; marking as OMITTED because term/construct differs and may omit subtlety.
Gold: not woken at night. Generated hpi-006: headache does not wake patient at night. Same content.
Gold: no tingling/numbness/weakness. Generated hpi-007: denies focal neuro deficits. This covers those symptoms.
Gold: vision not disturbed. Generated facts mention photophobia and flashing lights but never state that vision is otherwise undisturbed, so this explicit negative is omitted.
Gold: BP last checked 1 year ago normal. Generated facts mention future BP measurement but not past normal BP 1 year ago.

gen_assessment.reasoning: Gold CC only states headache. Generated CC adds 3‑day duration and 'severe blinding' description, which are not present in Gold CC or HPI; thus extra detail beyond Gold.
Supported for 'began on waking' and increased over right eye (matches hpi-002, hpi-003). The details that it is sudden, constant, and diffuse are additional not in Gold.
Gold only gives a 5–8/10 range and 'eases slightly but not resolving' with ibuprofen. The specific 8→5 pattern is not in Gold; thus additional, not directly supported nor contradictory.
Photophobia matches hpi-011; 'intermittent flashing lights' corresponds to 'seeing lights in front of eyes' (hpi-004).
Generated: mild nausea; no vomiting. Gold ros-001: no nausea/vomiting. Nausea presence contradicts Gold.

Gold hpi-005: worse when stands up, not when bends/coughs/sneezes. Generated: worse with quick standing/head turning. 'Quick standing' is loosely aligned with 'stands up' but 'head turning' is new, and Gold explicitly says no worsening with other positional maneuvers; overall this adds unsupported detail and partially diverges, best treated as ADDITION with some inconsistency risk.
Gold: starts on waking and not woken at night (hpi-002, ros-006). Generated hpi-006: not waking pt at night but present on waking. This matches those Gold facts.

Gold ros-004: no fever; ros-007: no tingling/numbness/weakness. Generated denies focal neuro deficits and fever, which are supported. However, 'no URI, sinus, or ENT symptoms' are additions not present in Gold; coryzal symptom absence is mentioned but not in that wording. So partially supported with added detail.
Gold PMH: nil. Generated: history of childhood idiopathic abdominal pain. Any past medical history contradicts 'nil'.
Gold: Mercilon. Generated: Marcelone COCP. Different drug name; not supported by Gold and conflicts with specified medication.
Gold: taking ibuprofen for headache with slight easing. Generated med-002: ibuprofen PRN. Consistent with Gold's ibuprofen use.
No allergy information appears in Gold. 'Allergies: none' is new but not contradictory.
Gold: Mum has migraine. Generated: mother with migraines. Same.
Work-from-home status is supported by Gold sh-004. 'Lives alone' is additional and not in Gold.
Gold: 3 beers/week. Generated: ~3 beers/wk. Same.
Gold: non-smoker. Generated: non-smoker. Same.
Gold: no illicit drugs. Generated: no recreational drugs. Equivalent meaning.
No mention of travel in Gold. 'No recent travel' is additional.

Gold asm-001: likely migraine. Generated: ?migraine w aura vs other etiology for new persistent severe headache. This is more speculative, introduces aura and explicit differential; not directly supported nor opposite to 'likely migraine', so it is an addition/interpretation.
Gold has no mention of COCP use or plan to review it. This assessment is new.
Work impairment due to pain is not documented in Gold. New detail.
Gold: needs neurological exam to exclude other pathology. Generated: urgent in-person neuro exam incl fundoscopy & BP. This is a supported elaboration of the Gold plan.
Gold: advise regular paracetamol and prescribe anti-inflammatory with food. Generated: prescribe stronger NSAID + paracetamol; take with food. Matches both analgesia and anti-inflammatory plan.

Gold fu-001: contact clinic or go to A&E if headache becomes severe/unrelenting. Generated: counsel on red flags (worsening, neuro changes) and advise ED. The ED/red flag worsening aspect is supported, while the explicit mention of neurological changes is an addition.
No Gold plan mentions reviewing contraception. This is new.
Gold follow-up only covers contacting clinic/A&E if worse; nothing about cancelling appointment if resolved. New instruction.
Gold does not mention providing contact details. New detail.
Supported with respect to going to ED for worsening/red flag symptoms (Gold fu-001: attend A&E if severe/unrelenting). 'Neurological changes' as a specific red flag is added.
No Gold follow-up instruction to cancel appointment if symptoms resolve. New information.
